title: Tangerine and Ginger Curd Tart with a Chocolate Layer
changes_from_base: A ginger-spiced pastry brushed with a thin chocolate seal and filled with a baked tangerine and fresh ginger curd instead of chocolate custard.
summary: A ginger pastry case sealed with dark chocolate and filled with a bright baked tangerine and fresh ginger curd.

ingredients.item: plain flour, plus extra for rolling
fine sea salt or table salt

ingredients.note: check the label for milk and soya

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Spiced dough
steps.text: pulse the flour, icing sugar, ground ginger and salt. Add the butter and pulse to a coarse meal, then the egg, just until crumbly clumps form. Wrap the disc and chill at least 1 h.

steps.title: Line and chill
steps.text: roll about 1 cm thick into a 28 cm round, fit it into the tin and trim. Prick the base with the fork and chill 30 min or more.

steps.title: Blind bake
steps.text: heat the oven to 160 °C (140 °C fan). Line with foil and beans and bake 20 min on the tray, then remove them and bake 15-20 min more until pale gold.

steps.title: Chocolate seal
steps.text: scatter the chopped chocolate over the hot base, wait 1 min, then spread it thin with the offset spatula. Leave 5 min. The thin chocolate layer keeps the pastry crisp under the curd.

steps.title: Tangerine curd
steps.text: whisk the yolks and whole eggs in the heatproof bowl. In the pan, bring the juices, half of each zest, the sugar, fresh ginger, salt and butter to a simmer. Pour slowly onto the eggs while whisking, tip back into the pan and stir over medium-low heat for 4-7 min, until it coats the spatula and reads 80 °C.

steps.title: Strain
steps.text: sieve into a bowl, then stir in the rest of both zests and the vanilla. Sieving removes the cooked zest and ginger fibres for a smooth curd.

steps.title: Bake again
steps.text: scrape the curd into the case and bake 25-35 min, until set at the edge but still a little wobbly in the middle. Cool completely on the rack.

steps.title: To serve
steps.text: top each slice with a spoonful of soured cream.

tips: Clementines or satsumas work if you cannot find tangerines.
Grate the ginger on a fine grater so it melts into the curd.
Zest the fruit before juicing; it is much easier.
Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 3 days. Bring to room temperature for 20 min before serving.
